nodes.description: Started once the account is signed in, on gpt-6-luna at high effort with project_doc_max_bytes 0 and the archboard_workhorse and archboard_voice tools. It runs turns only for a live voice session: a handoff, workhorse news, a spoken approval.

nodes.name: Realtime voice
nodes.responsibility: The realtime leg of that thread: the offer, the answer, the channel rule, a narrated walkthrough's steps, and the transcript
nodes.description: Archboard never reaches a voice provider itself. The child brokers the session; the media travels between the tab and the provider over the peer connection the tab made. The start tells the coordinator the [FINAL] and [COMMENTARY] channel rule, or for a recording to write only commentary; the board catalogue is kept on the coordinator's thread for the session's life.

nodes.responsibility: Runs the tool calls the coordinator makes, once each, against a replay ledger

nodes.description: Nothing is sent with no voice session. Every callback settles once as delivered, not delivered with a reason, or outcome unknown.

nodes.responsibility: The reviewed methods the coordinator and its realtime leg are started on

nodes.name: Workhorse operations
nodes.responsibility: Where anything sustained goes: the four operations the coordinator may ask of the workhorse, one at a time

nodes.name: Callback queue
nodes.responsibility: Takes news, operation events and pane reports in order, drops the session's own writes, and delivers one at a time

nodes.name: Workhorse news
nodes.responsibility: A turn on the linked workhorse that ended or began waiting on the user, whoever started it, as one plain sentence
nodes.description: Read from the workhorse thread's own turn/completed and thread/status/changed notifications: completed, failed, stopped or waiting, and a message from tell_coordinator. The sentence carries no identities; the coordinator reads the rest through inspect_workhorse.

nodes.name: Tell coordinator
nodes.responsibility: Answers the workhorse's tell_coordinator call: its message becomes news, or it is told nobody is listening

nodes.name: Callback delivery
nodes.responsibility: Gives each callback one path: news to a coordinator turn, the user's own pane changes to the voice model, the rest recorded only

nodes.name: Outcome report
nodes.responsibility: Gives the coordinator one piece of news as one turn/start, joining its running turn or starting one, and nothing while a recording holds the voice
nodes.description: The prompt says what happened and what to do with it: say it under [FINAL] if the user is waiting on it, keep it to a [COMMENTARY] line otherwise, and start no new work because of it.

walkthroughs.name: Why voice is its own thread

beats.heading: Two threads, two jobs
beats.body: The coordinator is a separate thread with its own model and settings, and the voice model's subconscious: it reads the boards, follows the workhorse and decides what the voice model says. It answers, investigates a little, and hands anything sustained to the workhorse, which goes on working while it talks.

beats.heading: The tools are frozen, and checked
beats.body: What the coordinator may ask for is a manifest pinned by digest, and every call is validated against it before it runs. A call that has already run is not run again.

beats.heading: Archboard brokers, it does not speak
beats.body: The tab makes the peer connection and carries the audio. Archboard passes the offer to the child and the answer back, and never holds a voice endpoint of its own.

beats.heading: The workhorse's news arrives at once
beats.body: A workhorse turn that ends or begins waiting on the user, whoever started it, and anything the workhorse says through tell_coordinator become one sentence of workhorse news. It goes out as one turn/start, which Codex adds to the coordinator's running turn or starts a turn with, so nothing waits for the coordinator to be idle and nothing enters its history without a turn that acts on it. What it answers under [FINAL] is spoken; a [COMMENTARY] line stays quiet.

beats.heading: Nobody is told without a listener
beats.body: With no voice session the coordinator never runs, so no news is sent and tell_coordinator answers that nobody is listening. While a recording holds the voice the outcome report sends nothing, because whatever the coordinator answered would be spoken into the video. Pane news goes to the voice model alone, and only for what the user changed by hand.

beats.heading: An approval is answered once
beats.body: A final spoken reply arms a gate on one approval. Whether it is then answered out loud or in the pane, it settles exactly once, and an unproven answer falls back to the narrowest outcome.

beats.heading: Archboard brokers, it does not speak
beats.body: The tab makes the peer connection and carries the audio. Archboard passes the offer to the child and the answer back, and never holds a voice endpoint of its own.

beats.heading: The workhorse's news arrives at once
beats.body: A workhorse turn that ends or begins waiting on the user, whoever started it, and anything the workhorse says through tell_coordinator become one sentence of workhorse news. It goes out as one turn/start, which Codex adds to the coordinator's running turn or starts a turn with, so nothing waits for the coordinator to be idle and nothing enters its history without a turn that acts on it. What it answers under [FINAL] is spoken; a [COMMENTARY] line stays quiet.

beats.heading: Nobody is told without a listener
beats.body: With no voice session the coordinator never runs, so no news is sent and tell_coordinator answers that nobody is listening. While a recording holds the voice the outcome report sends nothing, because whatever the coordinator answered would be spoken into the video. Pane news goes to the voice model alone, and only for what the user changed by hand.

beats.heading: An approval is answered once
beats.body: A final spoken reply arms a gate on one approval. Whether it is then answered out loud or in the pane, it settles exactly once, and an unproven answer falls back to the narrowest outcome.

beats.heading: Each tab hears only its own threads
beats.body: A tool call or notification goes to the tab session that owns its thread. So a coordinator's tool call runs against its own tab's workhorse, and a workhorse's news reaches only its own tab's coordinator. A tool call from a thread that no tab session owns is refused, so a running turn never waits on nobody.

adoptions.reason: TASK-371: the coordinator runs on gpt-6-sol at low reasoning effort
TASK-301: a coordinator carries at most one voice session; a voice start replaces one that already carried a session
A replaced coordinator thread is unsubscribed once its voice session closed and no turn runs on it, so Codex unloads it
